value: select xm,mz, csnyStr||'('||cast(strftime('%Y.%m', datetime('now'))-csnyStr as INTEGER)||')' as csnyStr,xrz,A0192E,photo,zwjb,CadreID from tb_cadre_node as b left outer join tb_Cadre as a on a.CadreID=b.ZwCadreID where zwjb in("正县","副县","正处","副处") group by cadreid order by dwID,zwOrder

select xm,mz, csnyStr||'('||cast(strftime('%Y.%m', datetime('now'))-csnyStr as INTEGER)||')' as csnyStr,xrz,A0192E,photo,zwjb,CadreID from tb_cadre_node as b left outer join tb_Cadre as a on a.CadreID=b.ZwCadreID where zwjb in("正科","副科") group by cadreid order by dwID,zwOrder

select xm,mz, csnyStr||'('||cast(strftime('%Y.%m', datetime('now'))-csnyStr as INTEGER)||')' as csnyStr,xrz,A0192E,photo,zwjb,CadreID from tb_cadre_node as b left outer join tb_Cadre as a on a.CadreID=b.ZwCadreID where mz!="汉族" group by cadreid order by dwID,zwOrder

select xm,mz, csnyStr||'('||cast(strftime('%Y.%m', datetime('now'))-csnyStr as INTEGER)||')' as csnyStr,xrz,A0192E,photo,zwjb,CadreID from tb_cadre_node as b left outer join tb_Cadre as a on a.CadreID=b.ZwCadreID where zzmm not in("中共党员","预备党员") group by cadreid order by dwID,zwOrder

select xm,mz, csnyStr||'('||cast(strftime('%Y.%m', datetime('now'))-csnyStr as INTEGER)||')' as csnyStr,xrz,A0192E,photo,zwjb,CadreID from tb_cadre_node as b left outer join tb_Cadre as a on a.CadreID=b.ZwCadreID where strftime("%Y.%m","now")-csnyStr <=35 group by cadreid order by dwID,zwOrder

select xm,mz, csnyStr||'('||cast(strftime('%Y.%m', datetime('now'))-csnyStr as INTEGER)||')' as csnyStr,xrz,A0192E,photo,zwjb,CadreID from tb_cadre_node as b left outer join tb_Cadre as a on a.CadreID=b.ZwCadreID where zwjb =="" or zwjb is NULL group by cadreid order by zwOrder
